description: Honeybee creates and runs daylight and building-energy simulations through Radiance, EnergyPlus and OpenStudio. Ladybug Tools provides a Grasshopper/Rhino interface and object-oriented software-development kits, with tutorials, component documentation and examples. It supports HVAC sizing, annual energy, comfort and daylight studies. The geometry and engine configuration still require checking; having a Honeybee model does not establish physically valid inputs. Published by Ladybug Tools. Spatial and temporal resolution are source-dependent; any detail not stated above remains unknown. Access is through the provider documentation and software links; no software was installed. Reuse licence: AGPL-3.0 for honeybee-core; extensions, engines and host CAD software have separate terms. The described release is free to access; licence restrictions still apply. Potential simulation uses include climate adaptation, optimisation. Related catalogue records: platform-ladybug-tools, model-energyplus, platform-openstudio. These are contextual links, not a claim of a tested integration.
